name: @anotoki/lib
description: What the anotoki sites share, the Angular half: the family's styles (@anotoki/lib/styles), UI kit (@anotoki/lib/ui and its entry points), top bar and frame (@anotoki/lib/shell), the migrations module (@anotoki/lib/migrations, @anotoki/lib/migrations/page) and the translations module (@anotoki/lib/translations, @anotoki/lib/translations/admin, @anotoki/lib/translations/testing). The PHP half is the Composer package anotoki/lib.
